native_asset_coverage.native_counter_semantics: Offline record lookups occur on geometry cache admission, not every draw. Zero new offline hits does not establish zero reuse of already resident offline buffers. Per-draw offline versus runtime origin coverage is not recorded.
native_asset_coverage.recipe_counter_semantics: Cumulative deltas between the first and last sample, not all game draws. Recipe rejection returns to the ordinary GX/GXM path; it does not establish software rendering or full asset reconversion.
